verses.text: Finally, my brothers and sisters, celebrate in the Lord! It doesn't bother me to repeat myself, and it keeps you safe.
Watch out for the dogs, those people who do evil, those who insist on physical circumcision.
We are the true circumcision—we worship by God's Spirit, celebrate in Christ Jesus, and put no confidence in human effort.
Even though I could have confidence in human credentials. If anyone thinks they have a reason to trust in them, I have even more:
I was circumcised on the eighth day, I'm from Israel and the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew born of Hebrews. As for the law, I was a Pharisee;
as for zeal, I persecuted the church; as for righteousness based on the law, I was blameless.
But whatever used to count as a gain for me, I now consider a loss because of Christ.
More than that, I consider everything a loss compared with the priceless value of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. I gave up everything for him and consider it garbage, so I can gain Christ
and be found in him—not with my own righteousness from the law, but with the righteousness that comes through faith in Christ, the righteousness from God based on faith.
I want to know Christ, the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming like him in his death,
so that somehow I may reach the resurrection from the dead.
I'm not saying I've already received this or become perfect, but I keep pursuing it to take hold of what Christ Jesus took hold of me for.
Brothers and sisters, I don't consider myself to have taken hold of it yet. But this one thing I do: I forget what is behind and reach forward to what lies ahead.
I keep moving toward the finish line to win the prize God called me to receive in Christ Jesus.
So all of us who are mature should think this way. And if you think differently about anything, God will make that clear to you too.
In any case, let's keep living by the truth we've already reached.
Brothers and sisters, join in following my example. Watch those who live by the pattern we gave you.
Many live as enemies of Christ's cross. I've often warned you about them, and now I say it with tears.
Their end is destruction; their god is their appetite; they're proud of what should shame them, and their minds are set on earthly things.
But our citizenship is in heaven, and we eagerly wait for a Savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ.
He will transform our humble bodies to be like his glorious body, by the power that lets him bring everything under his rule.
